description: Flat stamped steel mounting bracket/strap with exactly three in-line holes: two plain holes and one serrated hole.

identity.summary: Flat thin elongated steel strap with rounded ends, exactly three in-line holes, one serrated/toothed hole, and a VA emboss on the front face.
distinguishing_features: flat thin strap with rounded ends
one hole has a serrated/toothed rim and is the largest
VA emboss is expected on the front face

face.front: outer edge is chamfered/rolled; plain holes are countersunk/dished
face.back: outer edge is square/sharp; plain holes are flat through-holes

anatomy.va_location: between the middle hole and the plain end-hole, on the side of the middle hole opposite the serrated hole

decision.check: Identify the largest of the three holes, then inspect its outer rim/edge—not the bore fill.
decision.defect_when: The largest hole is confirmed and its rim is clearly a smooth continuous circle with no scallops/teeth.
decision.clear_when: The largest hole's rim clearly shows the expected scalloped/cog-toothed pattern.
decision.review_when: The designated hole or its rim cannot be resolved well enough to distinguish scalloped from smooth.
decision.boundary: A good serrated rim remains visibly scalloped even when the bore is bright or dished.
decision.localization: Tight box around the largest hole including its rim and bore; never a smaller hole or blank metal.

decision.check: After front face is established, inspect the VA marking at its designated location.
decision.defect_when: VA is present but one or more required characters is clearly shallower, fainter or less complete than the other.
decision.clear_when: VA is clearly present with consistent character depth and formation.
decision.review_when: A character difference could be glare, shadow, dirt or insufficient resolution.
ignore: Blank VA on the back face; that is normal.
decision.localization: Tight box around the affected VA character(s).

decision.check: Establish front/back from the outer-edge profile before reading the VA zone.
decision.defect_when: Front face is confirmed by a chamfered/rolled edge and countersunk plain holes, and the designated VA zone is blank.
decision.clear_when: Front face is confirmed and VA is present; or back face is confirmed and VA is blank.
decision.review_when: The outer-edge/countersink profile cannot reliably establish front versus back.
ignore: Using a blank VA zone alone to infer the back face.
Glare, shadow or dirt mistaken for a missing mark.
decision.localization: Tight box around the designated VA zone.
